fields.description: The bot's row UUID. Idempotency key for ingestion/sync - re-sending the same delivery must not create a duplicate.
fields.label: Bot Delivery ID

fields.description: Invoice number as typed by the driver - may be wrong, matched against real invoices during reconciliation.
fields.label: Reported Invoice No

fields.description: Verbatim driver name/handle as reported by the bot payload, before matching. Kept even after delivery_driver resolves to a Link, so an unmatched or mismatched report is still visible for manual review (Todo 028).
fields.label: Reported Driver Name

fields.description: Resolved from reported_driver_name / driver_telegram_id at ingestion (submit_delivery_report) or by the Todo 028 backfill patch for older rows. Blank if no Delivery Driver record matched - not auto-guessed to avoid a wrong link with no signal to catch it.
fields.label: Delivery Driver

fields.description: List of Frappe File URLs uploaded from the bot's photo_file_ids on sync.
fields.label: Photos

fields.description: Raw Telegram file_ids as received from the Worker's fire-and-forget write, e.g. {"photos": [...], "voice": "..."|null} - kept separately from `photos`/`voice_note` (which hold the *downloaded* Frappe File URLs) since ARCHITECTURE.md explicitly warns against conflating the two: `photos` already means "attached file URLs" on records from the old two-step bot flow. This is the input to the media sync job (api/telegram_media.py); it is not itself displayed to staff.
fields.label: Telegram File IDs

fields.description: Set by the media sync job when a Telegram file_id could not be downloaded (bad/expired file_id, over Telegram's 20MB getFile limit, or a token rotation - ARCHITECTURE.md failure mode #9). Never silent: any entry here also raises an admin alert. Blank means either sync succeeded fully or hasn't run yet - the sync job's own log/enqueue history disambiguates those two.
fields.label: Media Sync Error

fields.description: Explains which signal(s) auto-match used (exact/normalized/fuzzy invoice number, similarity score) so the reconciliation UI can show why a match was suggested.
fields.label: Match Notes

fields.description: Set on match/confirm - the reconciled invoice. Left blank until a human confirms the match.
fields.label: Matched Invoice

fields.description: Amount confirmed as collected at the delivery location (for Partial payment reconciliation).
fields.label: Amount Collected

fields.description: Set if the mark-as-paid step posted a Payment Entry.
fields.label: Payment Entry

fields.description: Resolved at ingestion (submit_delivery_report) by matching reported_invoice_no's numeric portion against an open Delivery Booklet's number range. Blank if no booklet range matched (see is_booklet_out_of_range) or reported_invoice_no isn't numeric.
fields.label: Booklet

fields.description: Set when reported_invoice_no is numeric but falls outside every known booklet's range - needs a human to either register the missing booklet or manually link one (Module 16).
fields.label: Booklet Out of Range

fields.description: Full original bot payload, preserved untouched even after fields above are edited during reconciliation.
fields.label: Raw Payload
